01 / About

Accounting professional. Remote bookkeeper.

I'm an accounting professional with 4+ years of hands-on experience in Record-to-Report and accounting operations, supporting processes including balance sheet reconciliations, journal and adjusting entries, month-end close, Opex accounting, accounts receivable and collections, financial reporting, and audit support.

I'm a Xero Certified Professional (Level 2) and QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor, building hands-on bookkeeping experience on both platforms. On Xero I work to Australian requirements — GST, BAS, PAYG withholding and superannuation. On QuickBooks Online I've run a practice company through the full cycle: setup, bills and invoices, bank feeds, reconciliation and financial statements.

02 / Case Studies

Four ways I prove the books are right.

Urban Loom is my QuickBooks Online case: a retail practice company run from setup to reconciled statements. Wesley Auto Repair demonstrates I can build a full accounting cycle by hand — from a blank chart of accounts to a balanced set of financial statements. GreenLeaf Eco Supplies covers end-to-end Xero bookkeeping for a GST-registered Pty Ltd, including BAS preparation. BrightPath Creative Studio applies the same process to a non-GST-registered business, highlighting the key differences in treatment.

📋
Portfolio Disclosure

All businesses featured in these case studies — including Urban Loom, Wesley Auto Repair Services, GreenLeaf Eco Supplies, and BrightPath Creative Studio — are entirely fictional and created solely for training and portfolio demonstration purposes. No real client data has been used. All figures, transactions, and reports were prepared as part of structured bookkeeping training exercises to demonstrate practical skills in Xero, QuickBooks Online, and Excel.

Manual bookkeeping — Excel

Wesley Auto Repair Services — full accounting cycle

Sole proprietorship · Period: 1–31 December 2019
Foundations · AU & US

Built a fully formula-driven Excel workbook from scratch for a fictional auto repair business — chart of accounts, general journal, general ledger, trial balance, and a complete set of financial statements — with journal entries as the only manual input and every statement updating automatically. A live dashboard flags Trial Balance and Balance Sheet status in real time.

Demonstrates: end-to-end manual bookkeeping — recording journal entries, posting to the ledger, proving debits equal credits, and preparing financial statements — with Excel used for organising data, performing calculations, and supporting financial analysis.

Xero · GST-registered Pty Ltd

GreenLeaf Eco Supplies — GST-registered full-quarter bookkeeping

Pty Ltd · Quarter ended 30 September 2025
Australia

Completed end-to-end Xero bookkeeping for GreenLeaf Eco Supplies Pty Ltd — an eco-friendly wholesale supplier registered for GST. Covered the full July–September 2025 quarter: coded 10 GST-inclusive sales invoices, categorised GST-on-expenses and GST-free expenses (software subscriptions), processed 3 months of payroll journals with PAYG withholding and superannuation, performed a CBA bank reconciliation, and prepared the BAS Activity Statement. Delivered zero unresolved discrepancies with a BAS payment of $5,447 owing to the ATO.

Demonstrates: GST coding (GST, GST-free, BAS-excluded), BAS Activity Statement preparation, PAYG withholding, superannuation journals, bank reconciliation in Xero, and end-to-end quarter-close for a GST-registered Australian business.

Xero · Non-GST-registered business

BrightPath Creative Studio — non-GST full-quarter bookkeeping

Sole trader · Creative services · Quarter ended 30 September 2025
Australia

Managed a full quarter of Xero bookkeeping for BrightPath Creative Studio — a graphic design studio below the $75,000 GST threshold and not registered for GST. Recorded 10 client invoices for design services (UrbanNest, EcoGlow, Bloom & Co.), processed all supplier bills (rent, software subscriptions, utilities, insurance), posted 3 months of payroll journals with PAYG withholding and superannuation entries, and performed a complete Westpac bank reconciliation. All 54 journal entries balanced with debits equal to credits, and the bank account reconciled to a closing balance of –$37,903.98 with zero outstanding items.

Demonstrates: Xero bookkeeping for a non-GST-registered business, AR/AP journal entries, payroll expense journals (PAYG + super), bank statement reconciliation, and understanding the $75,000 GST registration threshold — essential knowledge for working with Australian sole traders and small businesses.
